title: Sania smoothing wax: AI UGC product demo
summary: A 30 s vertical UGC-style ad (appears fully AI-generated) where a young woman talks to camera in a soft-lit vanity room, holds up the box, demos honey wax on her forearm in close-ups, shows the smooth result and ends on a pushed-in product shot on a marble counter. No graphics, no captions burned in; pure handheld-feel selfie footage with a cheerful voice.
fit_reason: Consumer beauty UGC with a 100% AI talking head: wrong audience, no UI, and it breaks Andrew's AI-video rules.

palette.mood: warm beige/blush natural light, golden honey tones

typography.display: none on screen (only the product packaging)
typography.notes: No captions in the export; a platform would add them.

motion: push-in close-ups on product and arm
transitions: hard cuts between talking head, demo close-up and result

sound.voiceover: yes - on-camera female creator, excited and casual ('Okay, I was not expecting this to work this well... Look how smooth that looks.')

signature_moves: surprised hook line to camera in the first second
product held up next to face
final hero product shot on counter

best_segments.what: Talking-head hook then box held to camera

recreate.how: Needs AI video (character + product consistency) or real creator footage; nothing to rebuild in code. Not suitable for SaaSSuite: only the hook structure (reaction line in first second, then proof) is worth borrowing with real Andrew footage.
recreate.prompt: Vertical selfie-style creator in a warm vanity room says a surprised hook line, holds the product to camera, demos it in close-up, shows the result, ends on a hero product shot.
